The search bar even reminds me I can use a word, a #label, an exact phrase, or and/or/not with parentheses.

It matches the behavior we approved feature by feature, and you've told me the checks all passed and the few issues you found were fixed. I'm happy with it — this is the bookmark app I set out to have. I accept it as complete for this cycle.

A couple of small wishes I'll just note for down the road, not anything to change now: I'd eventually like to peek at a saved page's snapshot straight from its card without opening the full details, and maybe rename a label everywhere at once. Thank you — this is exactly what I was hoping to end up with.
